title: Open world exploration
description: Unlock numerous areas to explore in
Freely walk around and choose what to do and interact with.
Chop trees to collect wood, mine for resources, forage, or do other activities while exploring!

title: Guilds
description: Team up with other players to rise amongst other guilds!
Select a profession to let members gain bonuses in that field.

title: Farming
description: Grow a variety of crops, tending to them by watering and harvesting.
Craft or purchase various fertilizers to help your crops.
Use materials to expand your farmland to cultivate a thriving agricultural empire!

title: Villages and Merchants
description: Visit the village in each area and purchase helpful items.
Sometimes a Merchant stops by a village. They'll sell items or upgrade your tools while they stay for the day!

title: Crafting
description: Learn new crafting recipes by leveling up, purchasing, or finding while exploring.
Use resources and materials to craft various items and equipment.

title: Fishing
description: Fish in any of the available areas, with fish differing between each one.
Complete an engaging and unique fishing minigame to reel in your fish.
Utilize baits to increase bite rate, quantity of fish, or fish rarity!

title: Battle
description: Engage in interactive turn-based battles against various monsters and foes
Defeat the monster and collect coins, xp, and monster items
Alternative to monsters, invite other players to a duel!

title: Profiles
description: Health and energy regenerate over time, but you can also eat food or use potions to recover.
Gain more coins and xp to become #1 on the leaderboards! Check globally, within the server, and even for various season intervals.
Collect badges and track your stats and achievements!
